name: Four cameras behind the nets, two at the sides (games 2-6 of the Barnburner tournament)
notes: Cameras 7 and 9 sit behind one net, 8 and 10 behind the other; 5 and 6 are at the sides.
Cameras are re-aimed every game, so nothing here depends on exact positions: the goalie
and net are assumed to fill the middle of each behind-the-net camera's view.
No readable scoreboard is described: clocks are found automatically in each game.
Grid cells refer to a 16 x 9 grid over each camera's frame (row 0 = top).
